topic: Dwell time calculation and cluster session recalculation
summary_markdown:
The team discussed the methodology for calculating dwell time. It was agreed that for the current release, the dwell time screen calculation should temporarily remain as 'as in impressions' and this feature will be moved to December. For a separate release, the fix for networks must use the formula: (dwell-time / sessions) + footfalls, but the dwell time used must adhere to the old scheme.

Additionally, it was decided that if no critical tasks arise, the team will proceed with recalculating sessions for the separated cluster. This involves using a test dataset and specific facility IDs (34387 and 28037) for the recalculation, including historical data from July.
decisions: The dwell time screen calculation remains 'as in impressions' for the current release and is postponed until December.
A separate fix for networks must use the formula: (dwell-time / sessions) + footfalls, using the old dwell time scheme.
Recalculation of sessions for the separated cluster will be performed if no critical tasks are pending.
action_items: The user needs to move the current development work into a separate branch to prevent accidental release.
Perform session recalculation for the separated cluster using provided facility IDs and historical data.
